scene.ko: 부칠 가방이 무게를 넘어 짐을 다시 싸고, 비행기 지연으로 환승편이 걱정되는 상황을 해결한다.

lines.en: Next, please. Could you put your bag on the scale?
lines.ko: 다음 분이요. 가방을 저울에 올려 주시겠어요?

lines.en: Sure. I'm on the flight to Sydney.
alt: Of course. I'm flying to Sydney.
Sure. My flight is to Sydney.

lines.en: I'm afraid your bag is four kilos over the limit. There's an excess baggage fee of 60 dollars.
lines.ko: 죄송하지만 가방이 제한보다 4킬로그램 무겁습니다. 초과 수하물 요금이 60달러예요.

lines.en: Oh, I didn't realize. Would it be okay if I moved a few things to my carry-on?
lines.ko: 아, 몰랐어요. 몇 가지를 기내 가방으로 옮겨도 될까요?
alt: Oh, I didn't know that. Can I move some things to my carry-on?
Sorry, I didn't realize. May I put some items in my carry-on?

lines.en: Of course. You can step aside and repack here.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 옆으로 비켜서 여기서 다시 싸셔도 됩니다.

lines.en: I've taken out my shoes and a jacket. Could you weigh it again?
lines.ko: 신발이랑 재킷을 뺐어요. 다시 무게를 재 주시겠어요?
alt: I took out my shoes and a jacket. Can you weigh it again?

lines.en: Perfect, it's under the limit now. However, I should let you know that your flight has been delayed by about two hours.
lines.ko: 좋아요, 이제 제한 안이에요. 그런데 알려 드릴 게 있는데요, 비행기가 두 시간쯤 지연됐습니다.

lines.en: Two hours? I have a connecting flight in Sydney. Will I still make it?
lines.ko: 두 시간이요? 시드니에서 갈아탈 비행기가 있는데요. 그래도 탈 수 있을까요?
alt: Two hours? I have a connection in Sydney. Will I be able to make it?
Really? I need to catch a connecting flight in Sydney. Is that still possible?

lines.en: Let me check... Your connection is too tight, so I've rebooked you on a later one at no extra cost. Here's a meal voucher for the wait.
lines.ko: 확인해 볼게요... 환승 시간이 너무 빠듯해서 추가 요금 없이 더 늦은 비행기로 다시 예약해 드렸어요. 기다리시는 동안 쓰실 식사 쿠폰도 드릴게요.

lines.en: I really appreciate your help. Is there anything else I need to do?
lines.ko: 도와주셔서 정말 감사해요. 제가 더 해야 할 게 있나요?
alt: Thank you so much for your help. Do I need to do anything else?

expressions.en: Would it be okay if I ___?

expressions.ko: 그래도 시간 안에 갈 수 있을까요?
